caption_style.description: Caption treatment shared by preview and export.

clip_audio_volume.description: Original footage audio bus; muted clips remain silent.

elementTransform.description: Canvas transform. x/y are percent of frame (0–100), center origin. scale* = 1 is identity. rotation is degrees clockwise.

duration_sec.description: Absolute-timeline duration of the In/Out effect (seconds).

transitionType.description: Clip-boundary transition. Legacy HANUMAN names + native FFmpeg xfade names (ADR 0007).

muted.description: When true, clip media audio is silent (editor mute).
When true, clip media audio is silent (editor mute).

words.description: Optional word-level clocks for karaoke / boxed highlight. When omitted, renderers estimate proportionally.
